rounds.name: Jutland Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Jutland peninsula comprises the continental mainland part of Denmark and northern Germany.

rounds.name: Gulf of Aqaba
rounds.fact: The Gulf of Aqaba is a northeastern arm of the Red Sea extending between the Sinai Peninsula and the Arabian Peninsula.

rounds.name: Gulf of California
rounds.fact: The Gulf of California is a marginal sea of the Pacific Ocean that separates the Baja California Peninsula from the Mexican mainland.

rounds.name: Cape Leeuwin
rounds.fact: Cape Leeuwin is the most south-westerly mainland point of the Australian continent.

rounds.name: Cape Verde Peninsula
rounds.fact: The Cap-Vert peninsula is the westernmost point of the African continent, upon which the city of Dakar is situated.
